title: Forward Chandra development checks
question: Do the forward effects recognize, render, recover and release GPU capacity in development?
method: Deploy the reviewed candidate, exercise live Standard and Chandra under a resident Nemotron service, cancel a bound active request, and read fresh typed and archived outputs.

outputs.role: Exact development deployment, runs and targeted test receipts

conclusion: Live standalone handoff, completed-archive rendering, fresh Chandra recognition and typed reading passed. Cancelling a live request drained its child and restored the service. Controlled same-run receipt recovery passed; source-ready cross-release rendering and full grouped qualification remain open.
